industry: Financial Services > Banks > Private Sector Bank

operating_notes.text: Emirates NBD Bank proposed open offer for 26% stake in RBL Bank at ₹280 per share pending statutory approvals.
As on the Identified Date, 44,503,282 RBL Bank shares (7.19% of equity capital) held by public shareholders were pledged.
Foreign shareholding in RBL Bank was 24.20% of paid-up equity capital as of the Identified Date.

Open offer price revised to ₹282.38 a share (₹280 offer price plus ₹2.38 applicable interest for 31 days of delay), maximum consideration ₹117,353,299,774.34 for 415,586,443 shares (26.00% of expanded voting capital).
Zero shares tendered in Emirates NBD open offer as of 17:09 PM.
Capital adequacy ratio improved to 33.28% from 14.25% in Q4FY26 due to capital infusion from Emirates NBD

timeline.summary: Emirates NBD Bank received SEBI observation letter for its open offer to acquire a 26% stake in RBL Bank at ₹280 per share.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹3,720.87 Cr (+7.0% YoY), net profit ₹244.42 Cr (+181.0% YoY).
RBL Bank reported Q4FY26 consolidated net profit of ₹244 Cr (+181% YoY) with advances growing 23% YoY to ₹114,232 Cr.
RBL Bank released the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on April 25, 2026.
On April 29, 2026, SEBI approved Emirates NBD Bank's change in control application concerning RBL Bank.
On May 4, 2026, RBL Bank held an Extraordinary General Meeting for amendments to its Articles of Association and chairman remuneration.
RBL Bank received RBI approval for amendments to its Articles of Association regarding Emirates NBD's director nomination rights.
RBL Bank announced Ministry of Finance approval for Emirates NBD to acquire up to 74% stake and amalgamate Indian operations on May 15, 2026.
RBL Bank receives all regulatory approvals for USD 3B (~₹26,850 Cr) Emirates NBD stake

On May 22, 2026, Emirates NBD's manager J.P. Morgan issued the Letter of Offer for a cash open offer of up to 415,586,443 RBL Bank shares (26.00% of expanded voting capital) at ₹282.38 a share, ₹11,735 Cr assuming full acceptance.
On May 29, 2026, RBL Bank disclosed the pre-offer advertisement cum corrigendum revising Emirates NBD's open offer timetable to 1–12 June 2026 at ₹282.38 a share, up to ₹11,735 Cr.
On June 1, 2026, RBL Bank disclosed that zero shares were tendered in Emirates NBD's open offer as of that date.
RBL Bank reported Q1FY27 PAT of ₹234.23 Cr, up 9.3% YoY, with capital adequacy ratio at 33.28% following preferential allotment to Emirates NBD
Moody's assigned first-time Baa2 issuer ratings to RBL Bank with stable outlook on July 30, 2026, citing affiliate support from Emirates NBD.
RBL Bank Limited released its Annual Report for FY 2025-26 and convened the 83rd AGM for September 2, 2026.
RBL Bank received a GST show cause notice for FY 2020-21 proposing demand of ₹103.77 Cr including interest and penalty
RBL Bank mobilised ~USD 3.40 billion FCNR(B) deposits (~₹324.72 billion) and extended ~USD 1.08 billion loans (~₹103.09 billion) under RBI swap facility till August 31, 2026.
RBL Bank Limited’s 83rd AGM on September 2, 2026, passed all resolutions unanimously, including standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY2026.
RBL Bank's Board approved establishing a USD 1 billion Euro Medium Term Note Programme for future foreign currency bond issuance.
Moody's assigned (P)Baa2 rating to RBL Bank's USD 1 billion MTN program with stable outlook on September 8, 2026.
CareEdge Global assigned BBB+/Stable rating to RBL Bank's USD 1 billion EMTN programme and issuer rating on September 8, 2026
RBL Bank approved pricing, tenure and other terms of USD 350 million senior notes under its USD 1 billion EMTN Programme on September 9, 2026.
RBL Bank intimated a proposed nationwide bank strike on September 11, 2026, with some branches possibly impacted.
RBL Bank listed USD 350 million senior notes on IFSC exchanges on September 16, 2026
RBL Bank received a GST show cause notice for FY 2022-23 proposing demand of ₹173 Cr including interest and penalty on September 29, 2026
RBL Bank reported provisional Q2FY27 results showing 34% YoY deposit growth to ₹15,628 Cr and CASA ratio improvement to 31.9%
On October 12, 2026, RBL Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹481.77 Cr and a Gross NPA of 1.02%.
RBL Bank reported Q2FY27 results with PAT of ₹482 Cr, driven by 170% YoY profit growth and improved asset quality.
RBL Bank received RBI approval for amalgamation of Emirates NBD Bank's Indian branches, effective December 1, 2026
RBL Bank Limited’s **Niti Arya** held one-on-one investor meets with Breakout Capital and Canara Robeco Asset Management on October 19, 2026, via video conferencing in Mumbai.
